+"""SEP-2640 Skills extension protocol primitives."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
+
+from mcp.server.context import ServerRequestContext
+from mcp.server.extension import Extension, MethodBinding
+from mcp_types import RequestParams
+
+EXTENSION_ID = "io.modelcontextprotocol/skills"
+
+
+class SkillsListParams(RequestParams):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow", populate_by_name=True)
+
+
+class SkillsGetParams(RequestParams):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow", populate_by_name=True)
+    name: str
+
+
+class ResourceDirectoryReadParams(RequestParams):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow", populate_by_name=True)
+    uri: str
+
+
+class Skills(Extension):
+    """Server-side SEP-2640 method bindings.
+
+    Handlers return protocol result dictionaries; their schema belongs to the
+    application/provider layer, not this protocol extension.
+    """
+
+    identifier = EXTENSION_ID
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        list_skills: Callable[..., Awaitable[Mapping[str, Any]]],
+        get_skill: Callable[..., Awaitable[Mapping[str, Any]]],
+        read_directory: Callable[..., Awaitable[Mapping[str, Any]]] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._list = list_skills
+        self._get = get_skill
+        self._read = read_directory
+
+    def methods(self) -> tuple[MethodBinding, ...]:
+        bindings = [
+            MethodBinding("skills/list", SkillsListParams, self._list_handler),
+            MethodBinding("skills/get", SkillsGetParams, self._get_handler),
+        ]
+        if self._read is not None:
+            bindings.append(MethodBinding("resources/directory/read", ResourceDirectoryReadParams, self._read_handler))
+        return tuple(bindings)
+
+    async def _list_handler(self, ctx: ServerRequestContext[Any, Any], params: SkillsListParams) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+        return await self._list(ctx, params)
+
+    async def _get_handler(self, ctx: ServerRequestContext[Any, Any], params: SkillsGetParams) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+        return await self._get(ctx, params)
+
+    async def _read_handler(self, ctx: ServerRequestContext[Any, Any], params: ResourceDirectoryReadParams) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+        assert self._read is not None
+        return await self._read(ctx, params)

Consider the following PR description:
Add SEP-2640 (Skills Extension) protocol support
[SEP-2640 (Skills Extension)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/pull/2640)
is Accepted, but the Python SDK has no support for it. It adds `skills/list`,
`skills/get`, and optional `resources/directory/read`, negotiated under the
`io.modelcontextprotocol/skills` extension.

We need to add the **protocol primitives** — a `Skills(...)` server extension
plus thin client wrappers and SEP-2640 validation — built on the existing
`Extension`/`MethodBinding` mechanism (like the shipped `Apps` extension), with no
schema or dependency changes. Filesystem discovery/caching would stay out of scope
for a higher-level provider.



</pr_description>
